newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania investigates French child sex suspect.
newsitem.headline: Romania investigates French child sex suspect.

text.p: A French citizen was arrested after allegedly being filmed having sex with two Romanian underage boys, but later released pending further investigation, police said on Friday.
A national police spokesman said the suspect, a lawyer from near Paris, had been arrested on Thursday at a flat near Bucharest's main railway station.
The head of Romania's transport police later said the public prosecutor's office had ordered his release while enquiries continued.

"We called for his arrest but the prosecution ruled that he could be investigated while remaining at liberty," Colonel Ilie Cornaciu said by telephone. The man was obliged to remain in Romania while the investigation was under way.
Police earlier said the Frenchman had entered Romania last month as a tourist and had confessed to having sex with 50 of 200 boys he had befriended during visits over two years.

A private Romanian television station showed footage on Thursday of what it alleged was a French-speaking man in his underclothes in bed with two boys. It said he had been undergoing psychiatric treatment in France.
Conviction on sex abuse offences under Romania's recently adopted criminal code carried a penalty of up to seven years.
A German citizen was charged earlier this month with sexual offences involving underage boys in western Romania.

Pornography and child prostitution have become rampant in Romania since the 1989 anti-communist revolt ended strict social controls. Hundreds of children from poor backgrounds leave their homes to live in squalor on Bucharest streets and are easy prey for paedophiles from Western countries.
